before.body:
Dear Maya,

Thank you for letting me know, and please don't apologize; these things happen.

Option 2 works best for me: Friday, October 2, 11:00 am CT, which is 12:00 pm ET. So my calendar now reads:

  * Wednesday, September 30, 2:00 pm ET: cancelled
  * Friday, October 2, 11:00-11:45 am CT / 12:00-12:45 pm ET: first-round case interview, by video

Thank you for rearranging it so quickly.

Best regards,
Sofia Okafor
MS Data Science, the College | TA, STAT 142

________________________________
From: Maya Lindqvist <maya.lindqvist@brightwater.example>
Sent: Sunday, September 27, 2026 6:40 PM
To: Sofia Okafor <sofia.okafor@example.com>
Subject: RE: Brightwater Strategy Group: first-round interview

Hi Sofia,

Apologies for the weekend email. Your interviewer has been pulled onto an urgent client deadline, so we need to move your interview on Wednesday, September 30 at 1:00 pm CT. I'm very sorry for the change. Here are two new options with a different consultant:

  Option 1: Thursday, October 1, 9:00 am CT
  Option 2: Friday, October 2, 11:00 am CT

Same format: 45 minutes by video. Let me know which works and I'll send a fresh link.

Best,
Maya

Maya Lindqvist
Campus Recruiter | Brightwater Strategy Group
Chicago Office
(312) 555-0163

before.body:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for your interest in Larkmoor Capital. I'm pleased to let you know that we'd like to invite you to a first-round interview for our 2027 Summer Analyst Program in Investment Banking.

The first round is a 30-minute video interview with a member of our coverage team, covering your background, your motivation and a few basic technical questions. Please reply to confirm that you'd like to move forward, and we'll get it scheduled for next week.

Best regards,
Jordan Lee
Campus Recruiter, Larkmoor Capital

This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the use of the individual to whom they are addressed. If you have received this email in error, please notify the sender and delete it. Larkmoor Capital does not accept liability for any errors or omissions in the contents of this message.

examples.demonstrates: Sign-off "Safe travels," kept with the name; title and phone lines removed; phone in the text anonymized

before.body:
Hi Marcus,

Here is your itinerary for the final round on Thursday, October 22. Everything is booked and paid for by Larkmoor.

Wednesday, October 21
  Train: departs Boston 4:10 pm, arrives New York 7:55 pm. Ticket confirmation LK7Q2M (e-ticket attached).
  Hotel: check-in from 3:00 pm, one night. It's a seven-minute walk from our office; the address and confirmation number are in the attached PDF.
  Dinner: expense up to $60, keep the receipt.

Thursday, October 22
  Hotel checkout: 11:00 am. The front desk can hold your bag.
  8:45 am: arrive at our office and check in at reception on the 14th floor with photo ID.
  9:00 am-12:30 pm: interviews (agenda to follow from Jordan).
  12:30 pm: lunch with two engineers from the team.
  Train home: departs New York 3:30 pm, arrives Boston 7:20 pm. Confirmation LK7Q2N.

Taxis between the station and the hotel are reimbursable. Please submit receipts within 30 days through the expense link in the attachment.

If a train is delayed or anything goes wrong on the day, call or text me at 212.555.0117.

Safe travels,
Tess Navarro
Recruiting Coordinator, Larkmoor Capital
212.555.0117

examples.demonstrates: Mailing-list email: same text in three inboxes; phone in the text anonymized; unsubscribe footer removed

before.body:
Hi everyone,

Welcome back! Fall recruiting moves fast, so here are the dates to put in your calendar now:

  * Resume workshop: Thu Sep 10, 4:00-5:00 pm, Wexley Hall 120
  * Career Fair: Thu Sep 24, 1:00-4:00 pm, Wexley Hall (register online by Sep 21)
  * Interview prep night: Tue Oct 6, 6:00 pm, virtual

Drop-in advising runs Monday to Thursday, 1:00-3:00 pm, no appointment needed.
For a 1:1 appointment, just reply to me or call the front desk at (617) 555-0140.


Studying abroad this term? All of our workshops are recorded, and advisors can
meet by video. Mention your time zone when you write.

Wishing you a great start to the semester,

Dana Whitfield
Senior Career Advisor | Career Center, Wexley Hall
(617) 555-0142

--
